item.title: Episode 3100: Inside the Billion-Dollar Cyber Fraud Machine (Digital Arrests, Simboxes & International Scam Networks)
item.description:
Inside the Billion-Dollar Cyber Fraud Machine: Digital Arrests, Simboxes & International Scam Networks.
Featured Experts: Joint CP Rajnish Gupta (Delhi Police IFSO) and Forensics Specialist Amit Dubey. Key Operational Topics: SIMBox telecommunication fraud, illegal GSM gateways, mule banking rings, forced-labor cyber scam compounds, and the critical 1930 National Cyber Helpline Golden Hour protocol.
🎧 Stream Full Episode on Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/episode/0gX4B6IDX6kgr1Ya9FU2Po?si=UtbrX5_YTRKQ3jKk0MN7xA 🌐 Access Dossier & Interactive Portal: https://rajkot.github.io/LOC-Cyber-Mobile-World-Special-Program-15-09-2026/
